UPSSSC Teacher Cadre JTC Final Answer Key 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released the final answer key for the recruitment of Teacher Cadre JTC Assistant Teacher posts on the official website of UPSSSC. This recruitment was released for 58 posts. Applications for the UPSSSC Teacher Cadre JTC Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 06 April 2026, to 27 April 2026. The written examination was conducted on 12 July 2026. Candidates who had appeared in this Examination can download their UPSSSC Teacher Cadre JTC Final Answer Key 2026 given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 06 April 2026
  • Last Date : 27 April 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 27 April 2026
  • Correction Last Date : 04 May 2026
  • Eligibility Result : 16 June 2026
  • Exam Date : 12 July 2026
  • Exam City Details : 02 July 2026
  • Admit Card Available : 08 July 2026
  • Answer Key : 13 July 2026
  • Final Answer Key : 12 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 25/-
  • SC, ST, Candidates : Rs. 25/-
  • PH Candidates: Rs. 25/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
